title: Release Engineer
job_description:
Our client, a dynamic organization in the technology sector, is seeking a DevOps Release Engineer to join their team. As a DevOps Release Engineer, you will be part of the Release Engineering department supporting development teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate adaptability, strong problem-solving skills, and a collaborative mindset, which will align successfully in the organization.

Job Title: Release Engineer (GitLab)

Location: Remote - USA

What's the Job?

Manage and optimize software release processes across multiple environments.
Support build releases and assist developers in troubleshooting build-related issues.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, focusing on automation and reliability.
Perform basic administration tasks for DevOps tools such as GitLab, Artifactory, Jira, and Jenkins.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and release workflows.

What's Needed?

Experience with CI/CD tools like GitLab, TeamCity, and Jenkins.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
Knowledge of DevOps tools including Artifactory, Jira, Confluence, and SVN.
Strong troubleshooting skills in both Windows and Linux environments.
Ability to work effectively during U.S. Central Time business hours.

What's in it for me?

Engage in a challenging role with opportunities for professional growth.
Work remotely from anywhere within the U.S.
Be part of a forward-thinking team migrating to modern infrastructure.
Contribute to impactful projects supporting development pipelines.
Join a company committed to diversity, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Upon completion of waiting period consultants are eligible for:

Medical and Prescription Drug Plans
Dental Plan
Vision Plan
Health Savings Account
Health Flexible Spending Account
Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
Supplemental Life Insurance
Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
Business Travel Insurance
401(k), Plus Match
Weekly Pay

If this is a role that interests you and you'd like to learn more, click apply now and a recruiter will be in touch with you to discuss this great opportunity. We look forward to speaking with you!
